Title: Generally Available: High Scale mode for Azure Monitor – Container Insights

Body.Content:
Container Insights is Azure Monitor’s solution for collecting logs from your Azure Kubernetes Service clusters.   

Announcing  the general availability of High scale mode in Container Insights to help customers achieve a higher log collection throughput from their AKS clusters.  When High Scale mode is enabled, Container Insights does multiple configuration changes leading to a higher overall throughput. All the changes are made in the background by the service and do not require input or configuration from customers. 

Learn more.
